just_in.excerpt: Three new PRISM investigations will scout underground shelters, map hidden ice, and monitor environmental hazards — the reconnaissance for humanity's first permanent lunar outpost.
just_in.image_caption: An artist’s concept of astronauts working at a future lunar base. NASA has selected three new science investigations to scout shelters, ice, and hazards for a permanent Moon outpost.
just_in.nri_angle: India, an Artemis Accords signatory with its own lunar ambitions through ISRO's Chandrayaan program, is a natural partner in the Moon Base era — and NASA's open science selections set the research agenda Indian planetary scientists will build on.

just_in.title: No, That Viral Turmeric Drink Will Not Melt 3 kg in a Week
just_in.excerpt: Fact-checkers rated the viral cinnamon-ginger-lemon-turmeric weight-loss claim misleading: the studies show only small, low-quality effects — and Ayurvedic experts say the promised results aren't scientifically justifiable.
just_in.image_caption: Turmeric roots (Curcuma longa); fact-checkers rated the viral weight-loss drink claim misleading (Wikimedia Commons)
just_in.nri_angle: The claim spreads fastest in the diaspora's family WhatsApp groups, where turmeric and ginger carry the authority of home — which is precisely why a fact-check grounded in both modern evidence reviews and Ayurvedic expertise matters to this audience.

just_in.title: GST Council Axes Arrest Powers, Halves Penalties in Sweeping Compliance Overhaul
just_in.excerpt: The 57th Council meeting recommended removing GST officers' arrest powers, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore, and automating refunds and registrations — with no rate changes on the table.
just_in.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses a media briefing after the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on October 8, 2026. The Council recommended removing GST officers’ arrest powers and halving the general penalty.
just_in.nri_angle: For NRIs running India operations or investing in Indian SMEs, the compliance overhaul lowers one of the biggest frictions of doing business in India — arbitrary enforcement risk — which is exactly the kind of structural change that moves the needle on India's ease-of-doing-business story.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Sensex Surges 879 Points as IT Stocks Lead Broad-Based Market Rebound
just_in.excerpt: The Sensex and Nifty each gained more than 1% on Friday, led by a 3% IT rally on strong TCS results — but persistent FII selling and Monday's CPI print will decide if the bounce holds.
just_in.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building is shown with rising market arrows. The Sensex gained 879.09 points on October 9, 2026 to close at 72,472.33, while the Nifty 50 rose 1.30% to 22,520.45.
just_in.nri_angle: For NRI investors with Indian equity exposure, Friday's bounce cut the week's earlier damage — but with FIIs still selling and the RBI's tightening cycle underway, the recovery hinges on Q2 earnings delivery rather than one day's short covering.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi Blunts Russia's Drive to Enclose the Donbas
just_in.excerpt: A four-phase counteroffensive launched in May has pushed Russian forces back north of Lyman, handed Moscow its worst month of net territorial gains since 2023, and proved maneuver warfare can still work under drone-saturated skies.

sources.label: Institute for the Study of War

just_in.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the war's battlefield direction shapes everything from global energy prices to the fate of Indian students still in Ukraine — and Vivaldi's surprise success complicates the assumption that time is automatically on Moscow's side.

just_in.title: 7.7-Magnitude Panama Earthquake Triggers Tsunami Alerts Across Nine Countries
just_in.excerpt: Buildings collapsed near the epicenter, a 6.6 aftershock followed, and tsunami warnings stretched from Central America to Chile's Easter Island — while the Panama Canal kept operating.
just_in.image_caption: Debris from the October 9, 2026 earthquake litters a street in Panama as residents assess damage to a car and storefronts. The 7.7-magnitude quake collapsed buildings near its epicenter in Herrera Province.
just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora travelers: Panama is a growing stopover hub between the Americas, and anyone with a Tocumen connection should confirm flight status before heading to the airport — while the canal, cruise lines, and expatriate retirement communities all watch the recovery.

just_in.title: JD Vance Casts Doubt on Livestreamed Execution, Says He Will Not Watch It
just_in.excerpt: The Pentagon plans a December 3 firing-squad execution for the Fort Hood shooter with the public invited to watch — but the vice president doubts the broadcast will happen and Trump stopped short of endorsing it.
just_in.image_caption: Vice President JD Vance in an official March 2026 portrait (Wikimedia Commons)
just_in.nri_angle: The case also reverberates through America's South Asian and Muslim communities, which have historically found themselves caught in the glare of terrorism prosecutions involving Muslim defendants — and now in the debate over how publicly that punishment should be staged.

just_in.title: HUD's FHA Crackdown Shuts Out Visa Holders as Home Loans Fall to Near Zero
just_in.excerpt: Non-permanent residents went from 5.8% of FHA purchase originations to 0.1% after the May 2025 rule change — and conventional lending has not picked up the slack.
just_in.image_caption: The Robert C. Weaver Federal Building, HUD headquarters in Washington, D.C. (Wikimedia Commons)
just_in.nri_angle: With Indians receiving roughly 70% of H-1B approvals, the FHA lockout hits the Indian diaspora's largest professional cohort directly — and in exactly the tech markets (San Jose, Salt Lake City, Raleigh) where Indian engineers buy their first American homes.

just_in.title: Bodycam Video Shows NYPD Rushing Man Shot by ICE Agent to the Hospital
just_in.excerpt: New footage shows officers racing Oscar Belgal, shot in the neck by an ICE agent with his child in the car, to the hospital themselves — as DHS defends the shooting and Mamdani escalates his fight to push ICE out of New York.
just_in.image_caption: A still from NYPD body-camera footage released October 9, 2026 shows officers attending to a wounded man on Marble Hill Avenue after an ICE agent shot him. Officers are seen carrying the man to a patrol car to rush him to the hospital.
just_in.nri_angle: The case tests how far federal immigration enforcement can go in a sanctuary city, and the bodycam footage is now central evidence in that fight — one immigrant New Yorkers of every background, including the city's large South Asian community, will be watching.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Ebola Outbreak Tops 8,700 Cases as Kenya Confirms First Imported Infection
just_in.excerpt: The DRC's Bundibugyo outbreak is now the country's worst on record at 8,728 cases and 4,205 deaths — and MSF says North Kivu is becoming its new, uncontrollable center.
just_in.image_caption: Ebola virus under electron microscopy (CDC, via Wikimedia Commons)
just_in.nri_angle: For the diaspora traveling to East and Central Africa or with family there, the key facts are concrete: Kenya's case was imported and contained with quarantine and tracing in place, the WHO rates global risk as low, and the vaccine trials now underway in Uganda are the first real path to a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine.

news.image_caption: Hurricane Isaias as seen from space. The storm shut in 72% of Gulf of Mexico oil output as crews evacuated 129 platforms.
news.nri_angle: US fuel prices will firm for Indian-American drivers across the Southeast, Florida could see brief fuel-delivery delays, and Gulf Coast travelers face possible flight and shipping disruption.

news.excerpt: President Zelensky called the October 7 strike on Pryluky — which fell on Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday — one of the most vile of the nearly five-year war.
news.image_caption: A representational image of missile damage to a residential building in Ukraine during the ongoing war. A Russian missile strike on an apartment block killed 19 people, including five children.

news.title: Pentagon Orders Military to Prepare for Renewed Strikes on Iran as Trump Weighs Move
news.excerpt: US Central Command has been told to finalize strike plans targeting Iranian energy, military and nuclear sites — even as Trump publicly rules out attacks before the November 3 midterms.
news.image_caption: The Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia. President Trump has ordered the military to prepare options for renewed strikes on Iran.
news.nri_angle: Any escalation around the Strait of Hormuz hits fuel prices globally and puts the large Indian diaspora in the Gulf — Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar — closer to a conflict zone; India has already had to reroute flights and issue advisories for nationals in the region.

news.title: Assam Student Found Dead by Andhra Railway Tracks After Reporting Harassment on Train
news.excerpt: Twenty-year-old Himashri Boro vanished from the Vivek Express in the early hours of October 6 after telling her family she felt unsafe; Assam's chief minister has written to his Andhra counterpart seeking a probe.
news.image_caption: A representational image. The body of 20-year-old Himashri Boro was recovered beside railway tracks in Srikakulam district, Andhra Pradesh, after she disappeared from the Vivek Express.
news.nri_angle: Millions in the diaspora travel India's railways on visits home; the case is a stark reminder that night-train safety precautions — helpline 139, the Rail Madad app, and sharing berth details with family — matter for every traveler.

news.title: 23-Year-Old Punjab-Origin Man Shot Dead in Targeted Attack Near Vancouver
news.excerpt: The Langley resident was found with gunshot wounds in a business-complex parking lot on October 5; a torched getaway car was recovered nearby, and homicide investigators say the attack appears targeted.
news.image_caption: Sailboats and the downtown skyline in Vancouver's Coal Harbour at sunset, where a 23-year-old Punjab-origin man was shot dead in a targeted attack.
news.nri_angle: The killing of a 23-year-old Punjab-origin man in a targeted shooting near Vancouver adds to a troubling pattern of gang-linked violence affecting young Punjabi men in British Columbia.

news.image_caption: Russian President Vladimir Putin, who told Iran's president Russia would 'do everything' to help end the Iran war
news.nri_angle: The prolonged Iran war has kept oil prices volatile and Hormuz shipping constrained, feeding fuel-price and inflation pressures felt in India and by the diaspora.

news.excerpt: Elon Musk accused Indian “oligarchs” of blocking Starlink and then named Mukesh Ambani directly; New Delhi insists its satellite rules are fair and non-discriminatory.
news.image_caption: A laptop displays the Starlink website. Elon Musk has accused Indian business interests of blocking Starlink's satellite-internet launch in India, directly naming Reliance chairman Mukesh Ambani.
news.nri_angle: The Musk-Ambani fight over satellite internet could reshape connectivity and prices for millions of Indian households, including families of NRIs in rural and remote areas.

news.excerpt: Valero, Marathon and Phillips 66 are on track for record third-quarter earnings as the Iran war, Middle East refinery damage and Ukrainian strikes on Russia drive diesel margins to historic highs.
news.image_caption: An oil refinery — U.S. refiners like Valero and Marathon are posting record profits as wars squeeze global fuel supplies
news.nri_angle: For NRIs, record fuel costs feed everyday U.S. inflation while surging refinery stocks have been among the market's best performers.

news.title: India Joins US and 13 Economies in Joint Push Against Global Industrial Overcapacity
news.excerpt: Fifteen economies signed a USTR-released statement targeting state-backed overproduction in autos, batteries, semiconductors and solar — with China notably absent and India itself under a separate US trade probe.
news.image_caption: A container ship — India joined the US and 13 other economies in a joint push against global industrial overcapacity.
news.nri_angle: The excess-capacity fight shapes where global manufacturing lands — and India is pitching itself as the alternative to China, a shift with direct implications for diaspora investors and trade professionals.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Pakistan Calls NYT Report of Its Jets Striking Houthis 'Fake and Fabricated'
news.excerpt: Islamabad denied that its air force flew strike missions against the Houthis even as the Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact faces its first test in the escalating Yemen war.
news.image_caption: The New York Times Building in Manhattan — Pakistan called the NYT's report of its jets striking Houthis 'fake and fabricated'.
news.nri_angle: Nearly 2.5 million Indians live in Saudi Arabia and Indian shipping and travel move through the region's lanes; Pakistan's military role in the Saudi-led war complicates India's diplomacy with both Riyadh and Islamabad.

news.excerpt: The advisory followed Houthi-claimed ballistic missile attacks on Riyadh and Abha airports; Air India, IndiGo, Air India Express and Akasa cancelled Riyadh flights until October 10.
news.image_caption: Riyadh's skyline at dusk. India advised its roughly 2.75 million nationals in the Kingdom to remain alert after Houthi-claimed missile strikes on Riyadh and Abha airports.
news.nri_angle: About 2.75 million Indians live in Saudi Arabia — the embassy's stay-alert advisory, the no-videos rule, and flight cancellations directly affect one of the diaspora's largest communities.

news.title: Modi Says Direct Benefit Transfers Saved Rs 5 Lakh Crore From Leakage
news.excerpt: At the 10th India Mobile Congress, the Prime Minister said Rs 50 lakh crore has flowed directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts, calling the mobile phone the backbone of governance.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks at the 10th India Mobile Congress in New Delhi. He said India's Direct Benefit Transfer system saved nearly Rs 5 lakh crore from falling into wrong hands.
news.nri_angle: NRIs with family in India should ensure relatives' Aadhaar-bank seeding is current, since subsidies and pensions now arrive only via direct DBT transfers.

news.excerpt: A crowded bus stop in eastern Ukraine's Donetsk region was struck around 10 a.m. Thursday; regional officials accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians as public transport was suspended in two cities.
news.image_caption: Firefighters extinguish the burned-out shell of a city bus in Kramatorsk after a Russian glide-bomb strike. The attack killed at least 30 people and wounded 18 on Thursday, Ukrainian authorities said.

nri-world.excerpt: The Forever stamp, featuring artist Sangita Bhutada's rangoli photographed by Bijay Dixit, will be unveiled Oct. 21 at the Embassy of India in Washington — a decade after the first U.S. Diwali stamp.
nri-world.image_caption: A rangoli of lit diyas in Goa. The USPS unveiled its new Rangoli Diwali stamp ahead of the festival ceremony.
nri-world.nri_angle: A Diwali stamp is among the most visible forms of mainstream U.S. recognition for Indian Americans, placing Hindu festival imagery on everyday mail a decade after the community's 2016 campaign win.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Thousands of Minnesotans May Be Canadian Citizens Without Knowing It
nri-world.excerpt: A change to Canada's Citizenship Act that took effect in December 2025 removed the first-generation limit — and with it, the cap on how far back claims can run.
nri-world.image_caption: The Minneapolis skyline seen from the Stone Arch Bridge. More than 47,000 Minnesotans report Canadian or French Canadian ancestry, and a December 2025 law change may make many of them dual Canadian-American citizens.
nri-world.nri_angle: The C-3 change directly affects Indian-Canadian families who moved to the US: US-born children of Canadian citizens, once cut off by the first-generation limit, may now already be Canadian citizens.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Chennai's 'Wall of Hope' Gives Young Voices a Canvas on Mental Health
nri-world.excerpt: The youth-led installation, unveiled at the IIT Madras Research Park by SCARF's Department of Youth Mental Health, opens days ahead of World Mental Health Day.
nri-world.nri_angle: The youth-led mental health wall at IIT Madras Research Park reflects a stigma-fighting model that matters to NRI families worried about pressures on young people both in India and abroad.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Nick Grewal Named 2026 Entrepreneur of the Year for Building ePropelled
nri-world.excerpt: The New Hampshire Tech Alliance honored the ePropelled founder at its October 6 Innovation Summit, capping a four-decade career that runs from Nashoba Networks to a global propulsion company with an engineering center in Chennai.
nri-world.image_caption: ePropelled founder and CEO Nick Grewal (left) poses with former New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu. Grewal was named the New Hampshire Tech Alliance's 2026 Entrepreneur of the Year at its October 6 Innovation Summit in Nashua.
nri-world.nri_angle: ePropelled's engineering and development center in Chennai puts Indian engineers at the heart of a global propulsion-tech supply chain, linking Grewal's recognition directly to Indian tech talent.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: HUD's FHA Crackdown Shuts Out Visa Holders as Home Loans Fall to Near Zero
immigration.excerpt: Non-permanent residents went from 5.8% of FHA purchase originations to 0.1% after the May 2025 rule change — and conventional lending has not picked up the slack.
immigration.image_caption: The Robert C. Weaver Federal Building, HUD headquarters in Washington, D.C. (Wikimedia Commons)
immigration.nri_angle: With Indians receiving roughly 70% of H-1B approvals, the FHA lockout hits the Indian diaspora's largest professional cohort directly — and in exactly the tech markets (San Jose, Salt Lake City, Raleigh) where Indian engineers buy their first American homes.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Bodycam Video Shows NYPD Rushing Man Shot by ICE Agent to the Hospital
immigration.excerpt: New footage shows officers racing Oscar Belgal, shot in the neck by an ICE agent with his child in the car, to the hospital themselves — as DHS defends the shooting and Mamdani escalates his fight to push ICE out of New York.
immigration.image_caption: A still from NYPD body-camera footage released October 9, 2026 shows officers attending to a wounded man on Marble Hill Avenue after an ICE agent shot him. Officers are seen carrying the man to a patrol car to rush him to the hospital.
immigration.nri_angle: The case tests how far federal immigration enforcement can go in a sanctuary city, and the bodycam footage is now central evidence in that fight — one immigrant New Yorkers of every background, including the city's large South Asian community, will be watching.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: ICE Agent Shoots Man in NYC; Mamdani Calls Trump, Demands ICE Out
immigration.excerpt: An ICE officer shot 28-year-old Oscar Belgal in his car in Marble Hill on Oct. 8 while a 5-year-old child sat inside. Mayor Mamdani spent two hours on the phone with Trump and DHS's Markwayne Mullin trying to free the wounded man — then demanded ICE leave New York City entirely.
immigration.image_caption: Zohran Mamdani addresses a rally, alongside scenes from a protest against ICE in New York City. Mamdani called President Trump to demand ICE be pulled out of the city after an ICE agent shot a man in NYC.
immigration.nri_angle: The Marble Hill shooting intensifies federal-versus-city immigration enforcement tensions in NYC boroughs where South Asian immigrants live, with Mayor Mamdani framing ICE operations as a public-safety threat to immigrant communities.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Canada Puts $20 Million Behind Fast Track to Ontario Licences for Foreign-Trained Doctors
immigration.excerpt: Health Canada's October 7 funding expands Practice Ready Ontario, letting experienced internationally trained physicians qualify for family medicine through a 12-week clinical assessment instead of a two-year residency.
immigration.image_caption: A physician consults with a patient in a medical clinic in Ontario. Health Canada committed $20 million on October 7, 2026, to expand the Practice Ready Ontario fast track for internationally trained doctors.
immigration.nri_angle: India-trained doctors are among the largest groups of internationally trained physicians in Canada; the 12-week fast track to Ontario licensing directly addresses the licensing barriers that have kept thousands out of medicine.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Indian Workers Begin Signing Payout Deals in €31 Million Milan Consulate Settlement
immigration.excerpt: Nearly 300 workers, most recruited in India, will receive an average of €50,000 each in back pay and damages after prosecutors found they were paid less than $2 an hour on the U.S. consulate construction site.
immigration.image_caption: Scaffolding covers the construction site of the new U.S. Consulate General in Milan, with a worker in an orange vest visible on the structure. Prosecutors found that nearly 300 workers on the project, most recruited in India, were paid less than $2 an hour, and workers have begun signing payout deals under a nearly €31 million settlement.
immigration.nri_angle: Most of the exploited workers were recruited in India; the settlement shows how overseas Indian labourers can use host-country legal protections to recover wages and secure residence status.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Ontario Calls in Police as College Recruitment Pipeline Under Scrutiny
immigration.excerpt: Ontario has referred suspected criminal misuse of student financial aid at private career colleges to provincial police, after inspectors linked student accounts and $219 million in public funds to a network of immigration recruitment firms.
immigration.image_caption: An Ontario Provincial Police cruiser. Ontario has referred suspected criminal misuse of student financial aid at private career colleges to the OPP for investigation.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian students are the primary market for the recruitment pipeline under scrutiny; families paying lakhs in agent fees face the greatest losses when colleges lose aid eligibility or collapse.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: GST Council Axes Arrest Powers, Halves Penalties in Sweeping Compliance Overhaul
markets-finance.excerpt: The 57th Council meeting recommended removing GST officers' arrest powers, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore, and automating refunds and registrations — with no rate changes on the table.
markets-finance.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses a media briefing after the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on October 8, 2026. The Council recommended removing GST officers’ arrest powers and halving the general penalty.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs running India operations or investing in Indian SMEs, the compliance overhaul lowers one of the biggest frictions of doing business in India — arbitrary enforcement risk — which is exactly the kind of structural change that moves the needle on India's ease-of-doing-business story.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Sensex Surges 879 Points as IT Stocks Lead Broad-Based Market Rebound
markets-finance.excerpt: The Sensex and Nifty each gained more than 1% on Friday, led by a 3% IT rally on strong TCS results — but persistent FII selling and Monday's CPI print will decide if the bounce holds.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building is shown with rising market arrows. The Sensex gained 879.09 points on October 9, 2026 to close at 72,472.33, while the Nifty 50 rose 1.30% to 22,520.45.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRI investors with Indian equity exposure, Friday's bounce cut the week's earlier damage — but with FIIs still selling and the RBI's tightening cycle underway, the recovery hinges on Q2 earnings delivery rather than one day's short covering.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nifty 50 Profits Seen Growing 20% as Earnings Accelerate Despite Market Slump
markets-finance.excerpt: Five brokerages expect Nifty 50 net profit to rise about 20% in the September quarter, building on a 10-quarter high — even as record foreign selling pushes the index toward its worst year in 15.
markets-finance.image_caption: A trader monitors stock prices on a screen at a brokerage in Mumbai. Brokerages forecast Nifty 50 net profit growth of about 20% for the September quarter, even as foreign investors sell Indian equities at a record pace.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Diaspora investors with India mutual fund, ETF or direct equity exposure face a split: record foreign selling has crushed the Nifty while corporate profits accelerate — earnings season will show whether fundamentals reassert themselves.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Is Indian Manufacturing's Moment Finally Here? The Data Is Mixed
markets-finance.excerpt: The Economist says Indian industry is having its moment — but factory surveys, PLI payout data, and value-addition figures paint a more complicated picture.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Bokaro Steel Plant in Jharkhand. India's manufacturing PMI rose to 55.1 in September, a seven-month high — though steel, batteries, solar and textiles lag behind electronics assembly.
markets-finance.nri_angle: NRIs investing in India need a clear-eyed read: manufacturing's gains are concentrated in electronics, pharma and food processing, while batteries, solar and textiles lag — pick exposure by sector, not by theme.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: TCS Beats Street Estimates as Q2 Profit Rises 15% to ₹13,884 Crore
markets-finance.excerpt: India's largest software exporter reported ₹73,188 crore in revenue, declared a ₹12 interim dividend, and crossed a $3 billion annualised AI revenue run-rate on two landmark transformation deals with Porsche and Best Buy.
markets-finance.image_caption: A Tata Consultancy Services campus in Electronic City. TCS reported Q2 profit of Rs 13,884 crore, beating street estimates.
markets-finance.nri_angle: TCS is the anchor blue-chip for many diaspora investors in Indian equities; its 15% profit beat, ₹12 dividend with an October 14 record date, and $9.6 billion deal pipeline signal stability in Indian IT during a volatile market week.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Asia Stocks Fall as Oil Surge, Rising Yields Weigh; Samsung Slips on Record Profit
markets-finance.excerpt: MSCI's Asia-Pacific index fell 0.3% on Thursday as Brent crude topped $104 a barrel on U.S.-Iran escalation fears and 10-year Treasury yields neared multi-decade highs. Samsung Electronics slid despite a record $80 billion quarterly profit after the result fell short of some analyst estimates.
markets-finance.image_caption: The market centre at the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Asian stocks fell as surging oil prices and rising bond yields weighed on markets.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Surging oil prices and rising U.S. yields are direct headwinds for India as a major oil importer, pressuring the rupee, fuel prices and foreign investor flows into Indian equities.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Foreign Investors Pulled ₹21,745 Crore From Indian Stocks in Late September
markets-finance.excerpt: Foreign portfolio investors sold ₹21,745 crore ($2.3 billion) of Indian equities in the second half of September, intensifying a selloff led by financials, oil & gas, and auto stocks as rising US yields and crude prices drove a global allocation reset.
markets-finance.image_caption: A candlestick stock chart illustrating the September 2026 wave of foreign outflows from Indian equities. FPIs withdrew roughly Rs 35,860 crore from Indian stocks during the month.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs with Indian equity exposure, the selloff is a global-allocation rotation rather than an India-specific verdict — and with domestic institutions absorbing more than foreigners sold, SIP flows and large-cap entry points look healthier than the outflow headlines suggest.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Americans' One-Year Inflation Expectations Hit 3.9%, Highest Since May 2023
markets-finance.excerpt: The New York Fed's September Survey of Consumer Expectations shows households bracing for faster price growth across gas, food, rent, medical care and college costs — keeping the central bank on track for another rate hike before year end.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, DC. The New York Fed's Survey of Consumer Expectations showed one-year inflation expectations rising to 3.9%, the highest since May 2023.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For the diaspora, higher-for-longer US rates keep mortgage and loan costs elevated while supporting the dollar — a direct factor in remittance value and NRI portfolio returns.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nvidia Nears $6 Trillion on Record Highs and Biggest Buyback Ever
markets-finance.excerpt: Shares hit a record $239.11 as the AI chipmaker closes in on the first-ever $6 trillion market cap, powered by a $150 billion buyback and a $108 billion revenue outlook.
markets-finance.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The AI chipmaker closed at a record high this week, pushing its market value toward $5.8 trillion.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For diaspora investors with US retirement accounts, Nvidia's roughly 7–8% weight in the S&P 500 means its swings land directly in index portfolios, whether or not they hold the stock itself.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Indian Banks Face a Q2 Paradox: FCNR Flood Boosts Loans, Squeezes Margins
markets-finance.excerpt: Brokerages expect Q2FY27 bank earnings to rise about 11%, powered by 18.8% credit growth and $127 billion of FCNR deposits — but the foreign-currency funding is set to shave 8–20 basis points off net interest margins.
markets-finance.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India, with a pedestrian walking past the entrance. HDFC Bank grew deposits 19% year-on-year in Q2FY27, outpacing its loan growth of over 15%.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The $127 billion came from NRI pockets, and FCNR(B) deposits' foreign-currency denomination keeps depositors' returns free of rupee risk — though rates on fresh deposits are likely to soften as banks deploy the liquidity.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Shai Hope's Century Powers Record Chase as West Indies Level T20 Series
sports.excerpt: An unbeaten 102 from Shai Hope dragged West Indies past 250 in Ranchi, sealing the highest successful T20I chase in their history and leveling the five-match series 1-1.
sports.image_caption: West Indies captain Shai Hope in action during the second T20I against India in Ranchi. His unbeaten 102 powered West Indies to a record 250-run chase to level the series 1-1.
sports.nri_angle: India–West Indies cricket is a marquee draw for the Indian diaspora in the US and Caribbean, and a record chase keeps a five-match series alive heading into Indore on Sunday.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: New Zealand Hit by Double Injury Blow Ahead of India T20I Series
sports.excerpt: Mark Chapman and Zak Foulkes are ruled out of the five-match series; Josh Clarkson and Blair Tickner join the Black Caps squad for the opener in Christchurch on October 22.
sports.image_caption: Mark Chapman in action for New Zealand. The batter was ruled out of the five-match T20I series against India with a left hamstring tear.
sports.nri_angle: The India tour of New Zealand — a rematch of the 2026 T20 World Cup final — is appointment viewing for diaspora cricket fans, and NZ's depleted squad reshapes the contest.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Para-Shooters Allege Selection Fraud, Protest at Asian Para Games Send-Off
sports.excerpt: Akash and Sandeep Kumar questioned their exclusion from the Aichi-Nagoya squad at the Delhi ceremony attended by Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya; PCI chief Devendra Jhajharia called the process "100 per cent fair."
sports.image_caption: A 10m air rifle victory ceremony at the 2018 Summer Youth Olympics. Indian para-shooters Akash and Sandeep Kumar staged a protest at the contingent's New Delhi send-off Thursday, alleging score manipulation in Asian Para Games squad selection.
sports.nri_angle: NRIs follow India's para athletes closely; a transparent selection system is what keeps that trust — and the careers of Indian-origin athletes — intact.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Vithya Targets Sub-54 After Smashing PT Usha's 42-Year-Old Record
sports.excerpt: The 28-year-old hurdler became the first Indian woman under 55 seconds at Aichi-Nagoya. She says domestic competition doesn't push her — and she wants to race the world's best to go faster.
sports.nri_angle: Vithya's demand for world-class racing fields abroad is a story diaspora athletics fans know well — India's best need global exposure to become global champions, and sub-54 would make her India's first world-class women's hurdler.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Asian Games Gold Medallist Ritu Negi Excluded From Rs 1 Crore Award List
sports.excerpt: Himachal Pradesh raised its cash award for three of its Asian Games kabaddi gold medallists to Rs 1 crore each plus government jobs — leaving out Ritu Negi, the fourth member of the winning squad.
sports.image_caption: Indian kabaddi player Ritu Negi. The Asian Games gold medallist was excluded from the Rs 1 crore award list.
sports.nri_angle: Himachali and Indian diaspora communities celebrating the kabaddi gold will notice the uneven recognition of a gold-winning squad member — a reminder that transparent reward rules matter more than ad hoc generosity.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: 71% of India's Asian Games Medals Came From Just Five Sports
sports.excerpt: Athletics, shooting, archery, boxing and wrestling produced 60 of India's 85 medals at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 — a concentration that keeps India fourth in Asia but raises questions about Olympic breadth.
sports.image_caption: India's men's hockey team celebrates on the field at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. India finished fourth with 85 medals, but 71% of them came from just five sports: athletics, shooting, archery, boxing and wrestling.
sports.nri_angle: The diaspora follows the Asian Games as a barometer of India's rise — the cricket, kabaddi and hockey golds travelled through community screenings worldwide — but the narrow medal base shows the sports pipeline is still concentrated in a few disciplines.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Young Indian Wrestlers Denied US Visas Ahead of U23 World Championships in Las Vegas
sports.excerpt: Nine of 16 Indian wrestlers who appeared for visa interviews at the US Embassy in New Delhi were refused on Wednesday — told they were below 20 and unemployed; the WFI has asked the embassy to reconsider ahead of Thursday’s appointments.
sports.image_caption: Kushti wrestlers grapple in a sand akhara in Varanasi. Young Indian wrestlers were denied US visas ahead of the U23 World Championships in Las Vegas.
sports.nri_angle: Indian fans in the US may watch a home-soil world championship without India's full squad, in a year when young Indians are facing tightened US visa scrutiny across categories.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Pramod Bhagat, Bhavina Patel to Lead India at Asian Para Games
sports.excerpt: The two Tokyo Paralympic medallists will carry the tricolour at the opening ceremony in Nagoya as India sends 121 athletes to the October 18–24 Games.
sports.image_caption: Para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat, Tokyo 2020 Paralympic gold medallist, will carry India's flag alongside table-tennis medallist Bhavina Patel at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games opening ceremony.
sports.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora in Japan gets a rare home-soil chance to support the country's para-athletes in person at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Sujeet Kalkal's Comeback From 2-9 Down Wins Asian Games Wrestling Gold
sports.excerpt: The 23-year-old Indian beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's 65kg freestyle final at Aichi-Nagoya on October 2, ending India's eight-year wait for an Asian Games wrestling gold.
sports.image_caption: Sujeet Kalkal celebrates with the Indian tricolor after his Asian Games victory. The 23-year-old fought back from 2-9 down to beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's 65kg freestyle final at Aichi-Nagoya on October 2.
sports.nri_angle: A 23-year-old from Bhiwani's stunning comeback ended an eight-year gold drought — the kind of underdog sporting moment that rallies the global Indian diaspora around the tricolor.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: The Big Sister Who Taught India to Win: Harmanpreet Kaur's Captaincy Legacy
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down after 14 years as India women's captain, leaving behind the country's first senior ICC title and a winning culture that will outlast her.
sports.image_caption: Harmanpreet Kaur, who stepped down this week as India women captain — the most successful captain in women's T20I history with 77 wins.
sports.nri_angle: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down as India women's captain, closing a 14-year leadership era crowned by the 2025 ODI World Cup title and the most T20I wins of any captain in history.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: NASA's New Moon Missions Will Hunt Lunar Caves, Ice, and Hidden Hazards
technology.excerpt: Three new PRISM investigations will scout underground shelters, map hidden ice, and monitor environmental hazards — the reconnaissance for humanity's first permanent lunar outpost.
technology.image_caption: An artist’s concept of astronauts working at a future lunar base. NASA has selected three new science investigations to scout shelters, ice, and hazards for a permanent Moon outpost.
technology.nri_angle: India, an Artemis Accords signatory with its own lunar ambitions through ISRO's Chandrayaan program, is a natural partner in the Moon Base era — and NASA's open science selections set the research agenda Indian planetary scientists will build on.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Apple's LG Smart-Home Gear Gets Exclusive iPhone Proximity Feature
technology.excerpt: Code found in iOS 27 shows iPhones will detect Apple's co-developed LG accessories on tap, popping a Dynamic Island hint for instant controls — as Apple stages a "Welcome home" event on October 13.
technology.image_caption: The Apple Home app icon from iOS 27. Apple is staging a HomeKit reboot with LG-built accessories, ahead of its "Welcome home" event on October 13, 2026.
technology.nri_angle: LG is already a trusted household brand in India, so Apple-ecosystem users in India and among NRIs get a familiar name on the accessories — even if iPhone-exclusive perks keep the lineup an Apple-first buy.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google Unveils Gemini Agent for Work as Enterprise AI Race Heats Up
technology.excerpt: At its "Gemini at Work 2026" event, Google Cloud introduced a single AI agent that works inside Workspace, Microsoft 365 and Slack, routing each task to the best model — Google's Gemini or Anthropic's Claude.
technology.image_caption: Google's Gemini app; Google Cloud unveiled a "Gemini agent" for work on October 8 (Wikimedia Commons)
technology.nri_angle: The enterprise agent race matters for Indian IT services professionals and global capability centers, whose daily work runs inside Workspace and Slack — whoever wins this layer sets the workflow standards and reskilling agenda for them.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: A Pikachu Plush Spent 67 Days Aboard the International Space Station
technology.excerpt: The ESA–Pokémon partnership for World Space Week sent a spacesuited plush into orbit with astronaut Sophie Adenot; 1,040 orbits later, the tour video is out.
technology.image_caption: A Pikachu plush in a custom spacesuit floats inside the International Space Station's Cupola observatory. The toy spent 67 days aboard the station as part of an ESA-Pokémon partnership marking World Space Week.
technology.nri_angle: The ISS crew includes Indian-origin NASA astronaut Anil Menon on Expedition 75 — and ESA's Pikachu partnership shows how space agencies are reaching the next generation of young space fans, including in India.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Manus Raises Over $500 Million in First Round Since Meta Breakup
technology.excerpt: Butterfly Effect's AI agent startup, unwound from Meta's $2 billion-plus acquisition by Beijing in April, now has fresh capital and a reported $500 million revenue run rate.
technology.image_caption: The Manus logo displayed on a screen. The AI agent startup raised more than $500 million in its first funding round since unwinding Meta's $2 billion-plus acquisition.
technology.nri_angle: The Manus raise signals accelerating commercial demand for AI agents — the same enterprise AI wave that India's IT services firms and 2,000+ global capability centres are racing to serve.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Scraps Landmark $5 Billion IPO, Blaming Market Volatility
technology.excerpt: The AI data-center builder withdrew its ASX listing — set to be Australia's biggest since Telstra — after investors balked at a $44 billion valuation; it will raise private capital instead.
technology.image_caption: Server racks and monitoring displays inside a data center. Firmus, which builds AI data centers, withdrew its landmark Australian listing on October 9, citing market volatility.
technology.nri_angle: A landmark AI-infrastructure IPO collapse that signals how selectively markets are now pricing the AI boom — relevant context for tech investors and professionals worldwide.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Jio's 1,600-Satellite Plan Gets Green Light as Starlink's India Launch Stalls
technology.excerpt: IN-SPACe has cleared Reliance Jio's low-Earth-orbit constellation as technically sound, while Starlink, JioSatcom and Eutelsat OneWeb await Home Ministry security clearances before switching on commercial services.
technology.image_caption: Elon Musk appears in a graphic showing Starlink satellites over India. Starlink has secured a satcom licence and IN-SPACe authorisation, but commercial services await a pending Home Ministry security clearance.
technology.nri_angle: For NRIs with family in India's remote regions, Jio's sovereign constellation promises affordable rural broadband — and SpaceX-style competition could cut the cost of staying connected.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: OpenAI Bans Russian and Iranian Networks Using ChatGPT for Influence Campaigns
technology.excerpt: The company says the Russian 'Dark Clark' operation was the most sophisticated front-identity campaign it has disrupted, while Iran's 'Bogus Bylines' placed nearly 100 articles in real outlets under fake journalist personas.
technology.image_caption: A silhouetted figure works at a bank of monitors in a dark operations room. OpenAI says Russian and Iranian operatives used ChatGPT to draft reports and content for covert influence campaigns targeting Latin America and other regions.
technology.nri_angle: One Russian front posed as a platform covering the Indian diaspora in Latin America — evidence that diaspora communities are prime targets for influence operations.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Navya Naveli Nanda Launches Naveli Ventures to Back India's Deep-Tech Ambitions
technology.excerpt: The Nanda Family Office's venture arm will invest across deep-tech, space, AI, clean energy, advanced manufacturing and health — formalising a strategy three years in the making.
technology.image_caption: Navya Naveli Nanda photographed in Mumbai. The entrepreneur formally launched Naveli Ventures, the Nanda Family Offices venture arm, on October 6, 2026, to back deep-tech and frontier-technology startups.
technology.nri_angle: Indian-origin deep-tech founders in the US often struggle to raise from Indian capital; a serious Naveli Ventures becomes another bridge between Silicon Valley's Indian founders and Mumbai's family money.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Cal AI's 19-Year-Old Founder Raises $10M for New AI Startup Persona
technology.excerpt: Zach Yadegari, whose calorie-tracking app was acquired by MyFitnessPal, raised $10 million led by Vine Ventures for Persona — an AI assistant starting in iMessage and moving to a $179 wristband.
technology.nri_angle: For the diaspora's large contingent of tech founders and engineers, Persona is one to watch — a second act from a teenager who already built one of the fastest-growing consumer AI apps of the decade.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Google's New AI Note-Taking App Transcribes Meetings Entirely Offline
technology.excerpt: AI Edge Foresight, an experimental Mac app built on EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4, keeps all audio and files on-device — a privacy pitch aimed at confidential meetings.
technology.image_caption: Google's AI Edge Foresight app transcribes meetings entirely offline on Apple Silicon Macs, with no cloud subscription required. (Pictured: Googleplex headquarters in Mountain View.)
technology.nri_angle: For the diaspora's large contingent of tech workers handling confidential work, on-device transcription is a genuine privacy upgrade — but the app is experimental and English-first for now.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Meta Deploys AI to Catch Ads That Secretly Funnel Users to Child Abuse Material
technology.excerpt: The company's new tools target "signposting" ads that look benign but route users to illegal material off-platform — and Meta says it actioned 5.3 million exploitation items in India this half-year.
technology.image_caption: A Meta logo displayed on a wall. The company said it actioned 33.2 million pieces of child sexual exploitation content on Facebook and Instagram in the first half of 2026.
technology.nri_angle: India accounts for roughly 16% of Meta's global child-exploitation takedowns, making this directly relevant to diaspora families whose children use Instagram and Facebook — and to relatives back home.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Daayra: A Gritty Exploration of Justice — Critics Divided on Its Execution
